letter: My career combines a B.Sc. in Civil Engineering, 3 years of commercial sales advisory, and over 3.5 years of digital marketing strategy. This mix allows me to understand technical product ecosystems and build marketing programs that resonate with commercial partners.

In my recent work, I managed an EGP 10M/month advertising budget, generated 700 qualified leads in a single month, and kept up 10–12 campaign activations per month. I also built AI content automation engines to deliver structured market intelligence and branded assets efficiently.

Schneider Electric's focus on energy efficiency, industrial automation, and expanding the EcoXpert and Alliance Partner Programs represents an exciting environment to apply structured partner enablement and digital GTM strategies.

I look forward to leveraging my experience in multi-channel campaign execution, cross-functional coordination, and content architecture to drive partner recruitment, engagement, and recurring service growth across the region.
